question: Which fast food restaurant lie within 120 kilometers in the south direction from Kindred Hospital Chicago Northlake, Northlake, IL?
sql:
WITH origin AS  (SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.89054 41.906867)',4326)::geography AS geometry)
SELECT * FROM pois, origin
WHERE ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.89054 41.906867)',4326)::geography, 120000)
AND amenity = 'fast_food'
AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 157.5 AND 202.5;
